semantics.rust_signature: fn tensor_expand_exact_native(input: &Tensor, sizes: &[i64], cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<Tensor, ShapeLayoutTransformPartOneError>
semantics.alias_rule: Task 63 read-only zero-stride view shares input storage
semantics.shape_rule: right-aligned broadcast with -1 retaining existing dimensions and checked leading axes
semantics.accumulation_dtype: f32 for VJP and not applicable to forward
semantics.device_rule: view preserves the canonical device and stream
semantics.numeric_rule: no forward arithmetic and deterministic broadcast-gradient sums
semantics.tolerance: bit exact forward and 1e-6 f32 gradients
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation and before returning the view
semantics.vjp_rule: Task 63 sums broadcast axes into the source shape
semantics.jvp_rule: Task 63 broadcasts the tangent with the same shape
